name: Signal Cluster: Intraday Validation (5min)
description: Validates session_gap, previous_high_low, candlestick patterns, and cusum on 5-minute intraday bars. Confirms transforms that require intraday data work correctly.
source:
# =============================================================================
# SIGNAL CLUSTER: Intraday Validation (5min bars)
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
o = src.o
h = src.h
l = src.l
c = src.c
v = src.v

# === SESSION GAP (real overnight gaps on intraday) ===
sg = session_gap(fill_percent=100)(o=o, h=h, l=l, c=c)

# === PREVIOUS DAY HIGH/LOW ===
pdhl = previous_high_low(interval=1, type=SessionTimeframe.day)(h=h, l=l)

# === CANDLESTICK (intraday-tuned period) ===
p_hammer = hammer(period=20)(o=o, h=h, l=l, c=c)
p_engbull = engulfing_bull(period=20)(o=o, h=h, l=l, c=c)

# === CUSUM on intraday returns ===
rets = returns()(c)
regime = cusum(threshold=5.0, drift=0.0, use_std_threshold=True, std_multiplier=3.0)(rets)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Prev Day High/Low',
    category='Levels',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Prev High', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Prev Low', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(pdhl.previous_high, pdhl.previous_low))

xy_lines(
    title='Gap Size (%)',
    category='Gaps',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Gap', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=sg.gap_size)
